header.content:
### Azure App Service Plans

Monitor CPU, memory, queue depths, network throughput, and TCP connection states for Azure App Service Plans.

Inspect the selected plans in the [Clouds App](</ui/intent/dynatrace.clouds/view_azure_service/#{"dt.timeframe":{"to":"$dt_timeframe_to","from":"$dt_timeframe_from"},"explorer.type":"webAppHosting","dt.smartscape.azure_microsoft_web_serverfarms":"$SmartscapeId"}>).

---

kpi-count.title: App Service Plans
kpi-count.description: Total number of Azure App Service Plans matching the current filter selection.
kpi-count.query:
smartscapeNodes AZURE_MICROSOFT_WEB_SERVERFARMS
| filter (matchesValue($PrimaryTag,"ANY") or arraySize(array($PrimaryTagValues)) == 0 or in($PrimaryTag:noquote, arrayConcat(array($PrimaryTagValues), array(""))))
| filter in(toString(id), array($SmartscapeId))
| summarize count = count()

kpi-cpu.title: Avg CPU Utilization
kpi-cpu.description: Average CPU utilization across all selected App Service Plans. Values consistently above 80% indicate the plan needs scaling up or out.
kpi-cpu.query:
timeseries val = avg(cloud.azure.microsoft_web.serverfarms.CpuPercentage),
  filter: {
    in(azure.subscription, array($Subscription)) AND
    in(azure.location, array($Location)) AND
    in(azure.resource.group, array($ResourceGroup)) AND
    (matchesValue($PrimaryTag,"ANY") or arraySize(array($PrimaryTagValues)) == 0 or in($PrimaryTag:noquote, arrayConcat(array($PrimaryTagValues), array("")))) AND
    in(dt.smartscape_source.id, iCollectArray(toSmartscapeId(array($SmartscapeId)[])))
  }
| summarize AvgCpu = avg(arrayAvg(val))

kpi-memory.title: Avg Memory Utilization
kpi-memory.description: Average memory utilization across all selected App Service Plans. High values signal capacity pressure and may require a higher SKU tier.
kpi-memory.query:
timeseries val = avg(cloud.azure.microsoft_web.serverfarms.MemoryPercentage),
  filter: {
    in(azure.subscription, array($Subscription)) AND
    in(azure.location, array($Location)) AND
    in(azure.resource.group, array($ResourceGroup)) AND
    (matchesValue($PrimaryTag,"ANY") or arraySize(array($PrimaryTagValues)) == 0 or in($PrimaryTag:noquote, arrayConcat(array($PrimaryTagValues), array("")))) AND
    in(dt.smartscape_source.id, iCollectArray(toSmartscapeId(array($SmartscapeId)[])))
  }
| summarize AvgMem = avg(arrayAvg(val))

kpi-disk-queue.title: Avg Disk Queue Length
kpi-disk-queue.description: Average disk queue length across selected plans. A sustained non-zero queue indicates disk I/O saturation that can degrade all apps on the plan.
kpi-disk-queue.query:
timeseries val = avg(cloud.azure.microsoft_web.serverfarms.DiskQueueLength),
  filter: {
    in(azure.subscription, array($Subscription)) AND
    in(azure.location, array($Location)) AND
    in(azure.resource.group, array($ResourceGroup)) AND
    (matchesValue($PrimaryTag,"ANY") or arraySize(array($PrimaryTagValues)) == 0 or in($PrimaryTag:noquote, arrayConcat(array($PrimaryTagValues), array("")))) AND
    in(dt.smartscape_source.id, iCollectArray(toSmartscapeId(array($SmartscapeId)[])))
  }
| summarize AvgDiskQ = avg(arrayAvg(val))

kpi-http-queue.title: Avg HTTP Queue Length
kpi-http-queue.description: Average HTTP request queue length across selected plans. A growing queue means requests are waiting for a worker thread and users experience increased latency.
kpi-http-queue.query:
timeseries val = avg(cloud.azure.microsoft_web.serverfarms.HttpQueueLength),
  filter: {
    in(azure.subscription, array($Subscription)) AND
    in(azure.location, array($Location)) AND
    in(azure.resource.group, array($ResourceGroup)) AND
    (matchesValue($PrimaryTag,"ANY") or arraySize(array($PrimaryTagValues)) == 0 or in($PrimaryTag:noquote, arrayConcat(array($PrimaryTagValues), array("")))) AND
    in(dt.smartscape_source.id, iCollectArray(toSmartscapeId(array($SmartscapeId)[])))
  }
| summarize AvgHttpQ = avg(arrayAvg(val))

chart-cpu.title: CPU Utilization by Plan
chart-cpu.description: CPU percentage per App Service Plan. Plans sustained above 80% CPU are at risk of throttling the apps they host — consider scaling up or enabling autoscale.
chart-cpu.query:
timeseries val = avg(cloud.azure.microsoft_web.serverfarms.CpuPercentage),
  by: {azure.resource.name, azure.subscription, azure.resource.group, azure.location, dt.smartscape_source.id},
  filter: {
    in(azure.subscription, array($Subscription)) AND
    in(azure.location, array($Location)) AND
    in(azure.resource.group, array($ResourceGroup)) AND
    (matchesValue($PrimaryTag,"ANY") or arraySize(array($PrimaryTagValues)) == 0 or in($PrimaryTag:noquote, arrayConcat(array($PrimaryTagValues), array("")))) AND
    in(dt.smartscape_source.id, iCollectArray(toSmartscapeId(array($SmartscapeId)[])))
  }
| sort arrayAvg(val) desc
| limit toLong($Limit)

chart-memory.title: Memory Utilization by Plan
chart-memory.description: Memory percentage per App Service Plan. High memory on a shared plan affects all apps hosted on that plan and may cause out-of-memory crashes.
chart-memory.query:
timeseries val = avg(cloud.azure.microsoft_web.serverfarms.MemoryPercentage),
  by: {azure.resource.name, azure.subscription, azure.resource.group, azure.location, dt.smartscape_source.id},
  filter: {
    in(azure.subscription, array($Subscription)) AND
    in(azure.location, array($Location)) AND
    in(azure.resource.group, array($ResourceGroup)) AND
    (matchesValue($PrimaryTag,"ANY") or arraySize(array($PrimaryTagValues)) == 0 or in($PrimaryTag:noquote, arrayConcat(array($PrimaryTagValues), array("")))) AND
    in(dt.smartscape_source.id, iCollectArray(toSmartscapeId(array($SmartscapeId)[])))
  }
| sort arrayAvg(val) desc
| limit toLong($Limit)

chart-disk-queue.title: Disk Queue Length by Plan
chart-disk-queue.description: Disk I/O queue depth per App Service Plan. A persistent non-zero queue means disk operations are serializing and will slow all hosted apps equally.
chart-disk-queue.query:
timeseries val = avg(cloud.azure.microsoft_web.serverfarms.DiskQueueLength),
  by: {azure.resource.name, azure.subscription, azure.resource.group, azure.location, dt.smartscape_source.id},
  filter: {
    in(azure.subscription, array($Subscription)) AND
    in(azure.location, array($Location)) AND
    in(azure.resource.group, array($ResourceGroup)) AND
    (matchesValue($PrimaryTag,"ANY") or arraySize(array($PrimaryTagValues)) == 0 or in($PrimaryTag:noquote, arrayConcat(array($PrimaryTagValues), array("")))) AND
    in(dt.smartscape_source.id, iCollectArray(toSmartscapeId(array($SmartscapeId)[])))
  }
| sort arrayAvg(val) desc
| limit toLong($Limit)

chart-http-queue.title: HTTP Queue Length by Plan
chart-http-queue.description: HTTP request queue depth per App Service Plan. A non-zero queue means incoming requests wait for a free worker — a leading indicator of latency spikes and timeouts.
chart-http-queue.query:
timeseries val = avg(cloud.azure.microsoft_web.serverfarms.HttpQueueLength),
  by: {azure.resource.name, azure.subscription, azure.resource.group, azure.location, dt.smartscape_source.id},
  filter: {
    in(azure.subscription, array($Subscription)) AND
    in(azure.location, array($Location)) AND
    in(azure.resource.group, array($ResourceGroup)) AND
    (matchesValue($PrimaryTag,"ANY") or arraySize(array($PrimaryTagValues)) == 0 or in($PrimaryTag:noquote, arrayConcat(array($PrimaryTagValues), array("")))) AND
    in(dt.smartscape_source.id, iCollectArray(toSmartscapeId(array($SmartscapeId)[])))
  }
| sort arrayAvg(val) desc
| limit toLong($Limit)

chart-bytes-in.title: Bytes Received Rate by Plan
chart-bytes-in.description: Average inbound bytes per minute per App Service Plan sorted by highest receivers. Use this to spot traffic spikes and identify plans receiving disproportionate load.
chart-bytes-in.query:
timeseries bytesIn = avg(cloud.azure.microsoft_web.serverfarms.BytesReceived),
  by: {azure.resource.name, azure.subscription, azure.resource.group, azure.location, dt.smartscape_source.id},
  filter: {
    in(azure.subscription, array($Subscription)) AND
    in(azure.location, array($Location)) AND
    in(azure.resource.group, array($ResourceGroup)) AND
    (matchesValue($PrimaryTag,"ANY") or arraySize(array($PrimaryTagValues)) == 0 or in($PrimaryTag:noquote, arrayConcat(array($PrimaryTagValues), array("")))) AND
    in(dt.smartscape_source.id, iCollectArray(toSmartscapeId(array($SmartscapeId)[])))
  }
| sort arrayAvg(bytesIn) desc
| limit toLong($Limit)

chart-bytes-out.title: Bytes Sent Rate by Plan
chart-bytes-out.description: Average outbound bytes per minute per App Service Plan sorted by highest senders. Use this to spot egress spikes and identify plans making data-intensive calls to downstream services.
chart-bytes-out.query:
timeseries bytesOut = avg(cloud.azure.microsoft_web.serverfarms.BytesSent),
  by: {azure.resource.name, azure.subscription, azure.resource.group, azure.location, dt.smartscape_source.id},
  filter: {
    in(azure.subscription, array($Subscription)) AND
    in(azure.location, array($Location)) AND
    in(azure.resource.group, array($ResourceGroup)) AND
    (matchesValue($PrimaryTag,"ANY") or arraySize(array($PrimaryTagValues)) == 0 or in($PrimaryTag:noquote, arrayConcat(array($PrimaryTagValues), array("")))) AND
    in(dt.smartscape_source.id, iCollectArray(toSmartscapeId(array($SmartscapeId)[])))
  }
| sort arrayAvg(bytesOut) desc
| limit toLong($Limit)

chart-tcp-established.title: TCP Established Connections by Plan
chart-tcp-established.description: Active established TCP connections per App Service Plan. A sudden drop signals connection resets or worker crashes; sustained growth may indicate connection leaks.
chart-tcp-established.query:
timeseries val = avg(cloud.azure.microsoft_web.serverfarms.TcpEstablished),
  by: {azure.resource.name, azure.subscription, azure.resource.group, azure.location, dt.smartscape_source.id},
  filter: {
    in(azure.subscription, array($Subscription)) AND
    in(azure.location, array($Location)) AND
    in(azure.resource.group, array($ResourceGroup)) AND
    (matchesValue($PrimaryTag,"ANY") or arraySize(array($PrimaryTagValues)) == 0 or in($PrimaryTag:noquote, arrayConcat(array($PrimaryTagValues), array("")))) AND
    in(dt.smartscape_source.id, iCollectArray(toSmartscapeId(array($SmartscapeId)[])))
  }
| sort arrayAvg(val) desc
| limit toLong($Limit)

chart-tcp-states.title: TCP State Distribution (Aggregate)
chart-tcp-states.description: All nine TCP connection states averaged across the filtered plans. A spike in FinWait, TimeWait, or CloseWait states indicates slow connection teardown or upstream service timeouts.
chart-tcp-states.query:
timeseries {
  established = avg(cloud.azure.microsoft_web.serverfarms.TcpEstablished),
  synSent = avg(cloud.azure.microsoft_web.serverfarms.TcpSynSent),
  synReceived = avg(cloud.azure.microsoft_web.serverfarms.TcpSynReceived),
  finWait1 = avg(cloud.azure.microsoft_web.serverfarms.TcpFinWait1),
  finWait2 = avg(cloud.azure.microsoft_web.serverfarms.TcpFinWait2),
  closing = avg(cloud.azure.microsoft_web.serverfarms.TcpClosing),
  closeWait = avg(cloud.azure.microsoft_web.serverfarms.TcpCloseWait),
  lastAck = avg(cloud.azure.microsoft_web.serverfarms.TcpLastAck),
  timeWait = avg(cloud.azure.microsoft_web.serverfarms.TcpTimeWait)
},
  filter: {
    in(azure.subscription, array($Subscription)) AND
    in(azure.location, array($Location)) AND
    in(azure.resource.group, array($ResourceGroup)) AND
    (matchesValue($PrimaryTag,"ANY") or arraySize(array($PrimaryTagValues)) == 0 or in($PrimaryTag:noquote, arrayConcat(array($PrimaryTagValues), array("")))) AND
    in(dt.smartscape_source.id, iCollectArray(toSmartscapeId(array($SmartscapeId)[])))
  }

chart-socket-overview.title: Socket Traffic Overview
chart-socket-overview.description: Total inbound and outbound socket counts aggregated across the filtered plans. A growing gap between inbound and outbound may indicate socket exhaustion or asymmetric load.
chart-socket-overview.query:
timeseries {socketIn = avg(cloud.azure.microsoft_web.serverfarms.SocketInboundAll), socketOut = avg(cloud.azure.microsoft_web.serverfarms.SocketOutboundAll)},
  filter: {
    in(azure.subscription, array($Subscription)) AND
    in(azure.location, array($Location)) AND
    in(azure.resource.group, array($ResourceGroup)) AND
    (matchesValue($PrimaryTag,"ANY") or arraySize(array($PrimaryTagValues)) == 0 or in($PrimaryTag:noquote, arrayConcat(array($PrimaryTagValues), array("")))) AND
    in(dt.smartscape_source.id, iCollectArray(toSmartscapeId(array($SmartscapeId)[])))
  }

chart-socket-outbound.title: Outbound Socket Detail by Plan
chart-socket-outbound.description: Outbound socket breakdown per App Service Plan: established, time-wait, and loopback. Sort by any column to surface the problematic plan. High time-wait counts indicate rapid connection churn; high loopback counts suggest heavy intra-host communication.
chart-socket-outbound.query:
timeseries {socketEstablished = avg(cloud.azure.microsoft_web.serverfarms.SocketOutboundEstablished), socketTimeWait = avg(cloud.azure.microsoft_web.serverfarms.SocketOutboundTimeWait), socketLoopback = avg(cloud.azure.microsoft_web.serverfarms.SocketLoopback)},
  by: {azure.resource.name, azure.subscription, azure.resource.group, azure.location, dt.smartscape_source.id},
  filter: {
    in(azure.subscription, array($Subscription)) AND
    in(azure.location, array($Location)) AND
    in(azure.resource.group, array($ResourceGroup)) AND
    (matchesValue($PrimaryTag,"ANY") or arraySize(array($PrimaryTagValues)) == 0 or in($PrimaryTag:noquote, arrayConcat(array($PrimaryTagValues), array("")))) AND
    in(dt.smartscape_source.id, iCollectArray(toSmartscapeId(array($SmartscapeId)[])))
  }
| sort arrayAvg(socketEstablished) desc
| limit toLong($Limit)

problems-kpi-active.title: Active Problems
problems-kpi-active.query:
fetch dt.davis.problems
| filter contains(toString(smartscape.affected_entities), "AZURE_MICROSOFT_WEB_SERVERFARMS") OR contains(toString(affected_entity_types), "azure_microsoft_web_serverfarms")
| filter event.status == "ACTIVE"
| filter isNull(dt.davis.is_duplicate) OR not(dt.davis.is_duplicate)
| summarize count()

problems-kpi-warnings.title: Active warning signals
problems-kpi-warnings.query:
fetch dt.davis.events.snapshots
| filter contains(toString(smartscape.affected_entities), "AZURE_MICROSOFT_WEB_SERVERFARMS") OR contains(toString(affected_entity_types), "azure_microsoft_web_serverfarms")
| filter event.type == "WARNING"
| dedup event.id, sort: {timestamp desc}
| filter event.status == "ACTIVE"
| summarize count()

problems-header.content:
### Problems & Warnings
Problems and warning signals for your Azure App Service Plans. [Investigate active problems](/ui/apps/dynatrace.davis.problems/).

problems-detail.title: Active problems details
problems-detail.query:
fetch dt.davis.problems
| filter contains(toString(smartscape.affected_entities), "AZURE_MICROSOFT_WEB_SERVERFARMS") OR contains(toString(affected_entity_types), "azure_microsoft_web_serverfarms")
| filter event.status == "ACTIVE"
| filter isNull(dt.davis.is_duplicate) OR not(dt.davis.is_duplicate)
| fields display_id, event.name, event.category, event.start
| fieldsRename id = display_id, problem = event.name, category = event.category, start = event.start
| sort category asc

warnings-detail.title: Active warnings details
warnings-detail.query:
fetch dt.davis.events.snapshots
| filter contains(toString(smartscape.affected_entities), "AZURE_MICROSOFT_WEB_SERVERFARMS") OR contains(toString(affected_entity_types), "azure_microsoft_web_serverfarms")
| filter event.type == "WARNING"
| dedup event.id, sort: {timestamp desc}
| filter event.status == "ACTIVE"
| fields event.name, event.category, event.start
| fieldsRename name = event.name, category = event.category, start = event.start
| sort category asc
